title: Custom attributes in the index
summary: Every custom attribute is stored with its argument text and the symbol it decorates (table attributes), library indexes too
intro: Read this when a rule or a query needs to know which declarations carry an RTTI attribute and with which arguments. Each [..] item is one row: attr_name, arg_text, line / col and symbol_id of the decorated class, field, routine, param or property; query it with drag-lint sql.

surfaces.example: drag-lint sql --db <file.sqlite> --query "SELECT a.attr_name, a.arg_text, s.qualified_name FROM attributes a JOIN symbols s ON s.id = a.symbol_id"
